description: P29 writes stages 1-4 (plan M6-M9 §5.7, decisions 25-26); P36 adds stages 5-8 (grow6, moot, champion, throne). It starts once the prologue is done (slice.completed: after the crown, or from world_start when the title skips the prologue) and leads the tracker from then on (Quests makes it the main quest). Through the Kings' Door onto the Kingsgate shelf, relight the beacon the toll-riders hold (the beacon's interaction, once their scouts are cleared: XP floored at level 7), grow to stage 4 at the Kingsgate shrine, then win the oaths of two of the three powers - Brannock, the Greywood and Aldmere - in any order (XP floored at level 11). The oaths stage shows the three powers' meeting places as leads (Brannock's green, Hollowmere's green, the war camp's edge). In the M7 build only Brannock's oath exists: the thread waits there until M8 adds the other two.

stages.objective: Step through the Kings' Door behind the crown altar

stages.waiting_text: Toll-rider scouts hold the beacon hill: drive them off, then light it.

stages.objective: Win the oaths of two of the three powers of the Old Kingdom
stages.waiting_text: Brannock's oath is open to you now; the Greywood's and Aldmere's come with the next build.
